name: A & S Electric Supply
old_description: Welcome to A & S Electric Supply, the number one source for all your electric and lighting needs. Electrical equipment is imperative to every job site.
about:
A & S Electric Supply operates from a facility on Polk Street in Newark, New Jersey. The company provides electrical and lighting supplies to customers across the region, serving as a local source for contractors and facility managers.

The distributor stocks a range of electrical components including circuit breakers, push buttons, wires, fittings, switches, and portable power supplies. It offers same-day delivery service to job sites and operates weekdays from 6 AM to 5 PM with Saturday hours until noon, catering to early-start construction schedules.

Its customer base includes construction crews needing electrical products for equipment and building installations, industrial building managers requiring wiring and repair supplies, laboratories using circuit breakers and push buttons for component assembly, and field workers relying on portable power when grid electricity is unavailable. The company notes that it addresses the unique requirements of larger industries while also accommodating smaller-scale projects.

The company emphasizes same-day delivery and early opening hours to help contractors and maintenance teams keep projects on schedule, positioning itself as a reliable partner for time-sensitive electrical supply needs.
